source_policy: Public systems are principle analogues only; never claim a private vendor recipe or copied asset.

themes.name: System-spatial
themes.trajectory_summary: Place semantic nodes, connect their relationships, then lock the supplied mark component by component.

foreground_plan.speed_profile: hierarchy stagger with a slow final lock

themes.public_analogue: Material, Fluent, Atlassian, and Carbon-style motion principles
themes.design_intent: Communicate state change, hierarchy, and spatial continuity through semantic movement.
implementation: move actors from semantic source locations
preserve parent-child spatial relationships
derive timing from distance and hierarchy

themes.name: Premium-quiet
themes.trajectory_summary: Trace the mark's measured outer contour first, then let the solid identity resolve with optical restraint.

foreground_plan.path_strategy: source contour trace followed by fill
foreground_plan.speed_profile: slow trace with a deliberate reading pause

themes.public_analogue: Restrained editorial motion and Apple-style purpose, hierarchy, and user-control principles
themes.design_intent: Create perceived value through restraint, material presence, optical alignment, and deliberate timing.
implementation: reveal the highest-value contour first
use small translation and scale ranges
reserve contrast changes for the final identity moment

themes.name: Developer-open
themes.trajectory_summary: Commit deterministic identity tokens in an inspectable sequence, one source component at a time.

foreground_plan.speed_profile: even token cadence with short pauses

themes.public_analogue: GitHub Primer motion principles and inspectable interface systems
themes.design_intent: Make transformation legible to technical users through explicit phases and reproducible state.
implementation: expose named phases and actor IDs
show construction through explicit dependencies
prefer exact state transitions

themes.name: AI-field
themes.trajectory_summary: Move deterministic external signals into their measured Logo pixels until the mark assembles from the field.

foreground_plan.path_strategy: seeded signals converge into measured actors
foreground_plan.speed_profile: accelerate into geometry and decelerate at lockup

themes.public_analogue: Public AI-product motion patterns using progressive disclosure, signal flow, and responsive feedback
themes.design_intent: Suggest intelligence through organized transformation rather than science-fiction decoration.
implementation: start from a stable semantic mark
guide abstract signals into real geometry
use deterministic seeded particles only as a secondary layer
end with a quiet canonical state

themes.name: Fintech-trust
themes.trajectory_summary: Use a bounded progress state to reveal the mark from its center, then settle into an unambiguous confirmation.

foreground_plan.path_strategy: center-outward progress gates the supplied actors
foreground_plan.speed_profile: steady processing with a bounded confirmation settle

themes.public_analogue: Predictable system feedback, hierarchy, and calm state-transition principles
themes.design_intent: Communicate reliability, controlled movement, and successful resolution.
implementation: use explicit start, processing, success, and idle states
keep security status unambiguous
make motion reversible or cancellable

themes.name: Security-shield
themes.trajectory_summary: Establish the measured Logo boundary first, verify the interior, and unlock the wordmark last.

foreground_plan.speed_profile: guarded boundary, quick verify, deliberate release

themes.public_analogue: Accessible system motion with explicit focus, status feedback, and user control
themes.design_intent: Convey boundary, verification, and controlled access.
implementation: reveal perimeter before interior detail
use one explicit verification transition
freeze safely when interrupted or hidden

themes.name: Commerce-energy
themes.trajectory_summary: Compress identity components at a shared origin, release them outward, and settle quickly into the lockup.

foreground_plan.path_strategy: compressed actors release from a shared origin
foreground_plan.speed_profile: short anticipation, fast release, rapid settle

themes.public_analogue: Public commerce-system interaction feedback and clear-affordance principles
themes.design_intent: Create approachability and action without making the brand feel unstable.
implementation: make the mark react to action context
use a small anticipatory cue
return rapidly to stable idle

themes.name: Automotive-precision
themes.trajectory_summary: Carry each supplied component along one directional velocity path and lock it with a controlled scan.

foreground_plan.path_strategy: single-axis actor travel with velocity continuity
foreground_plan.speed_profile: heavy forms slow; scan accent remains fast

themes.public_analogue: Engineering-oriented physical continuity, hierarchy, and controlled acceleration
themes.design_intent: Express mass, direction, precision, and mechanical confidence.
implementation: define physical source and destination for each actor
use velocity continuity at handoffs
slow large masses and sharpen small accents

themes.name: Sports-impact
themes.trajectory_summary: Compress the full supplied mark, release it along its dominant axis, and recover to a readable final silhouette.

foreground_plan.path_strategy: horizontal compression followed by directional release

themes.design_intent: Create energy through anticipation, compression, release, and recovery.
implementation: build tension with counter-motion
release along the mark's dominant axis
limit deformation so identity survives speed

themes.name: Cinematic-title
themes.trajectory_summary: Open a central title aperture through the dark field, expose the lockup in layers, and hold the reading pause.

foreground_plan.path_strategy: center aperture gates contour and lockup layers
foreground_plan.speed_profile: slow exposure followed by a long title hold

themes.public_analogue: Title-sequence staging grammar, not a studio pipeline claim
themes.design_intent: Reveal meaning through attention control, scale, silence, and composition.
implementation: establish atmosphere after composition is known
stage the primary identity moment
protect the final silhouette and reading pause

themes.name: Nature-flow
themes.trajectory_summary: Carry each supplied component on a smooth low-frequency current before it roots into the canonical position.
themes.public_analogue: Organic motion built from continuous curves and variable velocity
themes.design_intent: Imply growth, breath, flow, and connection without losing mark structure.
implementation: derive direction from the mark's curves
use low-frequency variation
couple secondary actors to the primary contour

themes.name: Gaming-world
themes.trajectory_summary: Spawn identity components on deterministic orbits, assemble them as quest rewards, and clear the field.

foreground_plan.path_strategy: deterministic orbital arrivals into actor targets
foreground_plan.speed_profile: spawn, accumulate, snap to reward, clear

themes.public_analogue: Interactive-entertainment motion grammar; no game asset or signature is copied
themes.design_intent: Create personality, reward, and world-building around a recognizable mark.
implementation: keep the hero mark stable
use secondary effects to signal state
make replay deterministic with a seed

themes.name: Accessibility-first
themes.trajectory_summary: Use semantic order and opacity only, preserving stable geometry, focus, and a static-safe canonical landing.

foreground_plan.path_strategy: ordered opacity with stable source geometry

themes.public_analogue: Apple, Fluent, Spectrum, and other public systems' purposeful-motion principles
themes.design_intent: Preserve orientation and feedback while minimizing vestibular, cognitive, and visual load.
implementation: design the static state first
replace large movement with opacity or color
keep keyboard focus and reading order stable
